### Run Operations

#### Create remote repository

_No operation description provided._

```bash
case "{{ visibility }}" in
  public|private|internal) ;;
  *)
    echo "visibility must be public, private, or internal" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
  echo "GitHub CLI (gh) is required." >&2
  exit 127
}
git -C "{{ repository_path }}" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
  echo "Initialize git before creating the GitHub repository." >&2
  exit 2
}
if git -C "{{ repository_path }}" remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "An origin remote already exists; skipping gh repo create." >&2
  exit 2
fi
gh repo create "{{ repository_name }}" \
  --source "{{ repository_path }}" \
  --"{{ visibility }}" \
  --description "{{ description }}" \
  --remote origin

```
